build_cbt_data: build the CBT dataset by downloading cbt.tar.gz and extracting it to the ParlAI datapath
run_build_function: run the build function to download and prepare the CBT task data for ParlAI
review_build_function: review the build function that downloads CBT data and marks it as built
summarize_build_function: summarize the build function that checks for existing data, downloads resources, and marks completion
refactor_build_function: refactor the build function to support versioned CBT dataset downloads and cleanup
